findings.title: Group the authorization predicate before returning it without filters
findings.body: When no service filters are supplied, getBaseConditions() returns the authorization SQL without enclosing parentheses. For team and organization scopes with members, that SQL contains a top-level OR. A raw query composed as `WHERE ${baseConditions} AND <date/status condition>` therefore applies the additional condition only to the personal-booking branch, while all authorized team bookings bypass it. The previous Prisma where object preserved the grouping automatically. Return `Prisma.sql` with parentheses around the authorization expression so consumers can safely combine the base predicate with other query conditions.
